words.text: I'm very, very bored and very, very lonely… What if I just had a friend?
I rose vertically above my house. I started to turn, 360. It was like history.
We are not afraid of each other. We are afraid of not knowing each other.

words.text: What follows I am a question. Because it is the unknown out there. And rather than fear and reject, it is explore, ask, experiment.
The hug is not a metaphor for connection. It is connection.

Two people, with clear and continuous consent, share an embrace. Eight slow breaths together. Soften head to toe on each exhale. Quietly repeat: I love you and I am proud of you. One silent breath apart at the end.
We only know self, we will only be now, the only thing we can ever do is choose.
Experiences do not happen to you; they are created within you. Mind your mind to see the magic all around us.

alt_song.title: the warm ending of Afraid of Not Knowing You

words.text: Because the self is the artwork. Never done. Never will be done.
1111, the analemma turns. Same frame, different altitude.
It's 2038… or maybe 2042. The year doesn't matter anymore. You're here. Looking back.
The crack was real. But so was the bridge.

passing.text: You never cross the same place twice, even if it appears like that.
Nine is the guest that displaces no one, the first note of the next octave.
